production_contract.alpha_policy: Generated repaint is retained inside the reviewed high-confidence subject matte; the reviewed transformed mask remains authoritative for antialiased visual edges only. Residual magenta spill is converted into the cool-blue shoreline palette before alpha is applied.
production_contract.geometry_policy: Artwork alpha is not collision, shallow-water, line-of-sight, or navigation truth.

common_prompt: Create a TinySeaWar 2D battle environment source master from the supplied exact 16:9 composition reference. Preserve the reference island silhouettes, gaps, counts, channel widths, and placement. Use strict orthographic top-down Japanese anime strategy-game environment art with polished cel shading and soft gradients: dark wet rock, pale sand, muted olive vegetation, low-saturation turquoise shallows, and sparse cool-white foam. No perspective, horizon, ocean background, ships, buildings, UI, text, border, or watermark. Place the isolated land artwork on uniform #ff00ff chroma-key background.
